name: Clean Copy
description: Ctrl+Shift+C copies the page address without tracking parameters, ready to share.

gallery.author: OyNIx
gallery.summary: Share the link, not the campaign.
gallery.about: Addresses picked up from newsletters and social apps carry tags like utm_source, fbclid or gclid that tell the site where you came from, and tell it again for everyone you pass the link on to. Press Ctrl+Shift+C on any page to copy its address with those tags removed. A short confirmation shows exactly what was copied. Parameters a page needs to work, such as a search term or video ID, are kept.
